artifacts.notes: Mame prints conditione and Per Dominum.; the target prints condicione and Per Dominum nostrum. The sixteen petition words agree under that received spelling; the historical two-word conclusion cue and target three-word conclusion remain distinct. Both images read clementia; the legacy dementia is a transcription error, not a declared spelling normalization. Exact projected Unicode body with final LF SHA256 7124589a58d990e82bde57e5490109b76db17d82ab7d9af302f13b94d51f8793. Only the September Ember Wednesday Collect petition is corrected. The preceding Kyrie, Oremus, Flectamus genua and Levate context is outside this body; no actor, frame or new appointment is inferred. Secret, Postcommunion and the separately owned Oratio 1616 are not newly verified here.
